name: Burpee (No Push-Up)
instructions: From standing, drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank position.
Jump your feet back to your hands and stand up explosively.
Add a small jump at the top for the full cardio effect. No push-up in this variant.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Burpee (No Push-Up) is an intermediate core exercise targeting the full-body, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
